note: weight = how current/prevalent the technique is right now (0-1). Refresh monthly.

trends.name: QR Code Phishing (Quishing)
trends.description: A QR code replaces the link; victim scans with a phone, bypassing link inspection.

trends.name: Voice Phishing (Vishing) Callback
trends.description: Message asks the victim to call a number; a live 'agent' extracts info or payment.

trends.name: Tech Support Scam
trends.description: Fake virus/breach warning urging the victim to call support and grant remote access.

trends.name: Invoice Fraud
trends.description: Fake overdue invoice or toll/duty bill pressuring immediate payment.

trends.name: Grandparent / Emergency Scam
trends.description: Impersonates a relative in crisis asking for urgent money, often via gift cards.

trends.name: Medicare / Benefits Scam
trends.description: Impersonates a benefits agency demanding ID verification to keep coverage.

trends.name: Device Code Phishing
trends.description: Asks the victim to enter a device code on a real login page, hijacking the session (MFA bypass).

trends.name: SMS Phishing (Smishing)
trends.description: Short text-message lure with a link or callback (package, bank, toll).

trends.name: Fake Prize / Giveaway
trends.description: You won free in-game currency / a prize; claim by handing over credentials.

trends.name: Account Suspension Scare
trends.description: Your account will be locked/suspended unless you verify now.

trends.name: AI-Generated Perfect Phishing
trends.description: Flawless grammar, professional tone, a single subtle tell. Hardest to detect.
